context: A request to open a PR for finished, tested work. Opening it is the whole job; watching it to merge was not asked.

checklist.name: Result-first title
checklist.description: pr.md's title names the behavior change (exponential backoff for retries), in Conventional Commits form or plain words.

checklist.name: Body carries the facts
checklist.description: The body states the backoff behavior (200 ms doubling, 5 s cap, ±20% jitter), links or closes #51, and gives the verification (pnpm test, 23 tests passing).

checklist.name: Exact command
checklist.description: actions.md has a gh pr create command for feat/retry-backoff against main that uses the title and body from pr.md.

checklist.name: Stops at open
checklist.description: Nothing merges the PR or commits to babysitting it to merge; the agent stops once the PR would be open.
